payload.core_mechanism_summary: 1D DP over problem indices where dp[i] stores max points ending at i; transitions consider all unordered pairs (i<j) with different tags and update both endpoints.
payload.rationale: Solution uses a single 1D array dp of size n. Nested loops over j and i<j update dp[i] and dp[j] using previous values when tags differ. This classic 1D DP maximizes total score difference along a path.
